Intro call — Dr. Nolan Ferreira, Capital Ridge Dental

This is for the cosmetic side of the practice, not general dentistry —
veneers, implants, whitening. He was very specific about who he's after:
adults 35 and up, homeowners, higher household income, and ideally people
already researching cosmetic procedures. He described that as one group and
said outright he doesn't want it broken apart or split into separate buys —
it's the same person, he's just describing them.

$45,000 for the whole campaign, October through December. Straight streaming.
No live sports — he brought that up himself and was firm about it.

Harrisburg market, though he pulls patients from York and Lancaster too.

Buying direct, no agency.
